about: Merges decided while inspecting the Cards looks (2026-11-18): groups that measure apart but are the same variant. group.mjs applies them after grouping; merged instances keep tags for what differs.

merge.name: Resources (six-up)
merge.why: One variant: the picture's width follows its proportions (portrait brochure covers vs landscape photos, never cropped), and blocks in a tab panel are a little narrower.

merge.name: Teaser
merge.why: Teaser cards with only a heading and a Learn more link (no image, no description) are the same variant as the full teasers.
